description: The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for different models. The x-axis is labeled “Cost” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score” with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A blue line, representing the “3-Model Ensemble”, begins at approximately 82 on the y-axis when x equals 0, and declines to approximately 73 when x equals 10; it includes circular markers. A red line, representing the “2-Model Ensemble”, begins at approximately 85 on the y-axis when x equals 0, and declines to approximately 75 when x equals 10; it also includes circular markers. An orange line, representing “GPT-4”, begins at approximately 80 on the y-axis when x equals 0 and decreases steadily to approximately 45 when x equals 10; it also includes circular markers.
